product_overview: Smart Axia Fleet Manager is a fleet management application that lets users sign in to access a dashboard summarizing vehicles, trips, and fleet status. The current frontend implements authentication (login and password recovery) and a protected main dashboard route.
core_goals: Sign in to a personal account to access fleet tools and data
Recover account access when a password is forgotten
View a high-level dashboard summarizing vehicles, trips, and fleet status
Quickly see operational metrics to support day-to-day fleet decisions

features.name: Authentication (Login & Password Recovery)
features.description: Allow users to sign in to their account and recover access via password recovery so they can access the protected dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login -> See main dashboard at /(tabs)/home
Navigate to /(auth)/forgotPassword -> Fill in email -> Submit password recovery request -> See confirmation that recovery instructions were sent
Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Fill in email with invalid format -> Fill in password -> Submit login -> See validation error about email format

features.name: Main Dashboard (Home)
features.description: Provide an authenticated summary view of the fleet: high-level vehicle and trip status, and key operational metrics available after signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to /(auth)/login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login -> See dashboard summary at /(tabs)/home
When authenticated, navigate to /(tabs)/home -> See dashboard summary with vehicles and trips overview
Navigate to / -> See login screen at /(auth)/login when not authenticated

features.name: Authentication
